cohort: 8 young women with early-stage endometrial carcinoma who were managed conservatively for fertility-sparing purposes in West China Second University Hospital, Sichuan University from June 16, 2008, to December 31, 2010.
finding: Hysteroscopic resection followed by progesterone therapy is a safe and feasible conservative management of early-stage endometrial carcinoma in selected patients wishing to preserve fertility, with successful pregnancies observed in a significant proportion of patients.
mod_finding: Of the 4 successful pregnancies, 3 resulted in live births delivered at term via cesarean section.
